sentences.en: This is a silly example, i.e. it exemplifies something silly.
sentences.zh: 这是一个愚蠢的例子，也就是说，它举例说明了某种愚蠢的东西。

sentences.en: His dedication to work truly exemplifies the meaning of professionalism.
sentences.zh: 他的敬业精神真正体现了专业性的含义。

sentences.en: The best way to exemplify a concept is with real-life examples, not just definitions.
sentences.zh: 用实际例子来举例说明一个概念要比仅仅给出定义好得多。

senses.zh: 作为…的典型例子；示范；例证
